body.statement: Conditional on effective compatibility density, suppose \(p_n(0)\to p_0\), the finite vectors \(c_n\) converge to \(c\in\mathcal K_0\), and \(\sup_{u\in C,j}|e_{n,j}(u)|\to0\) for every compact \(C\subset\mathbb R^d\). Apply CertGluePFL at a vanishing requested accuracy to the known experiment \(\mathfrak G_0(c_n)\), then transport the certified rule through Carter's positive-cell kernel. The resulting \(K_n\), which uses \(c_n\) but not the unknown limit \(c\), has semantic-label coverage deficit and separated-risk excess on \(C\) bounded by Carter's comparison error plus \(\mathfrak b_0(\tau_n)\), \(\max_j\sup_{u\in C}|e_{n,j}(u)|/\tau_n\), covariance and Gaussian-tail enclosures, semantic-union diameter inflation, and \(\rho_{\mathrm{led}}\). A computable diagonal choice \(\tau_n\downarrow0\) and certificate schedule makes this bound vanish.
body.justification: The finite slack list, compatibility subspace, and Gaussian band charge make offset adaptation a determinate uniform theorem rather than a promissory phrase.
body.gap: Kaido, Molinari, and Stoye calibrate drifting moment inequalities but do not transport a finite-label Gaussian minimax rule; Carter's kernel does not define or localize an active tangent arrangement.
body.consumer: The Job Corps rule handles known root-\(n\) drifts in the capacity, generalized-inverse, and endpoint-program faces while charging every observation falling near one of the explicitly enumerated active boundaries.

obligation.what_is_open: Construct one data-independent transferred rule with a global honesty receipt for the moving offset fan and prove the stated computable vanishing schedule.
obligation.obstruction: Boundary-band localization controls a fixed compact set, but it does not extend honesty to every mean in the unbounded finite-sample regions. Moreover qualitative convergence of \(e_{n,j}\) does not itself yield a computable diagonal; the proposed effectiveness assumption must first be adjudicated.
obligation.attempted: The exact slack decomposition isolates the offset, affine, and remainder terms, and the Gaussian band charge controls sign changes away from boundaries. Separate offset-specific Gaussian rules do not produce the required single globally honest multinomial rule.
obligation.partial_result: For every \(\tau>0\), disagreement between finite moving signs and offset signs is confined to the union of Gaussian bands \(\{|c_{n,j}+a_j^{\prime}W_0|\le\tau\}\) together with the event controlled by \(\max_j\sup_C|e_{n,j}|/\tau\). The first probability is bounded by \(\mathfrak b_0(\tau)\).
